entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire
proceedings of Case No. 3566 of 2020 (State Vs. Rajesh), arising out of Case Crime No. 769 of 2020,
under Sections 376, 313, 323, 506 Ipc, Police Station Vijay Nagar, District Ghaziabad, pending in
the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.06, Ghaziabad.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant has informed the Court that proceedings of the present case were already challenged by the applicant before this Court by filing Application U/s 482 No. 24187 of 2021 (Rajesh Vs. State of U.P. and Another), in which, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has granted interim order in favour of the applicant vide order dated 22.03.2022, however, it appears Rajesh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137432167/
1

entities.text: Rajesh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
that in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Pvt. Ltd. and Another Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in (2018) 16 SCC 299, the said interim order has been deemed to be vacated and thereafter, non-bailable warrant has been issued against the applicant.
4.

entities.text: Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Pvt. Ltd. and Another Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in (2018) 16 SCC 299
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicant is ready to appear before the court below and seek his bail and that his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
5.

entities.text:
Satender Kumar Antil Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears before the court below within three weeks from today and seeks bail, his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Nadim  Rajesh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137432167/
